inspirations.title: Brass Urli & Floating Jasmine Welcome Foyer
inspirations.description: Place three antique brass urlis filled with water, floating orange marigolds, tuberoses, and scented floating candles at the arrival walkway to greet guests with gentle fragrance.
inspirations.culturalContext: Traditional South Indian Mangala Vaadya welcome with auspicious water & flower symbolism.

inspirations.title: Interactive Live Filter Coffee & Steaming Holige Bar
inspirations.description: A rustic brass counter where fresh Mysore Pak and hot Bele Holige (Puran Poli) are roasted on tawa with desi ghee, served alongside metre-long froth filter coffee in traditional davarah-tumblers.
inspirations.culturalContext: Celebrates authentic Karnataka culinary hospitality with interactive spectacle.
